messages:
sam: Quick Q — onboarding for analytics infra team. Jenna needs to query billing-prod and infra-prod to triage an alert. We want least-privilege: view logs + run read-only BigQuery. Prefer NOT to give org-level viewer. What’s the recommended binding pattern?

maria: Project-level bindings are fine. Give roles/logging.viewer on infra-prod and roles/bigquery.dataViewer on the billing project (or dataset-level if you want narrower scope). Avoid roles/viewer at org. Optionally create a custom role if you need to drop a permission.

jeff: Also consider time-bound access — we should avoid permanent grants. IAM Conditions let you add a TTL like: 
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding infra-prod \ 
  --member=user:jenna@redwood.com \ 
  --role=roles/logging.viewer \ 
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-18T04:00:00Z"),title=temporary_triage'
```
That covers the logs side without org-level scope.

katie: If she gets logging.viewer, will she see raw payloads (emails/ip) in log entries? We need to ensure PII isn’t exposed.

maria: Good call. logging.viewer can read full entries. Two mitigations: 1) create a logs sink that exports only non-sensitive fields to a BigQuery dataset and give Jenna access to that dataset; or 2) grant direct logging.viewer but gate access behind a documented SOP + ticket + DLP review. There isn’t a built-in IAM split that hides payload but shows metadata.

sam: I like option 1. So create a sink with a filter that excludes user_email/identifiers and export to analytics-sandbox dataset, then give Jenna bigquery.dataViewer on that dataset. Cleaner audit trail.

jeff: FYI: sinks run as a service account. Make sure the sink SA has correct write perms on the dataset and we add a retention + audit alert if exports start containing PII labels.

katie: For the emergency triage we want short notice access to prod logs. Can we do both: a conditional logging.viewer for 8h + the sink approach for regular work?

maria: Yes — temporary conditional binding for immediate triage + follow-up request to grant dataset access for recurring investigations. Add an access request in #access-requests and attach the incident ID.

sec-bot: Access policy check: granting roles/bigquery.dataViewer on a dataset allows read of table data. If the dataset contains billing details, flag for review. Ticket created: AR-7219. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all — I’ll create the sink + temp binding and file the access request (AR-7219). Assigning to @maria for the DLP review afterwards. :thumbsup:

maria: Sounds good. Ping me in the ticket when the sink exists so I can run a quick DLP scan.

jeff: Leave a note with the exact condition expression you used so we can revoke any accidental longer windows.

sam: Will do — putting steps in the ticket now.
